description: This file is a comprehensive documentation detailing the design, APIs, operational workflows, capabilities, and system context of the Composite Input HAL interface, primarily aimed at software engineers and developers integrating or maintaining this hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: ICompositeInputManager
classes.description: Manager interface for discovering composite input ports and platform capabilities.

classes.name: ICompositeInputPort
classes.description: Interface providing control and metadata for individual composite video input ports.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Callback interface for receiving port connection, signal, and video mode change events.

classes.name: IPortTelemetryListener
classes.description: Callback interface for receiving port telemetry/metrics updates.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Data structure describing platform-wide features and capabilities.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Per-port capability flags, including support for metrics and properties.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Represents current connection status, signal status, and video mode of a port.

classes.name: Port
classes.description: Metadata about a specific port, such as name and description.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum representing signal detection states: NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Details of the detected video resolution and format.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data including lock time, signal drops, and uptime.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used for batch property retrieval.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Describes supported properties, types, read-only status, and whether they are metrics.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieve overall platform feature support and capabilities.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieve list of available composite input port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Get interface for a specific port by ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Get capabilities of a specific port, including supported properties and metrics.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieve the value of a specified property key.

methods.name: getPropertyMulti
methods.description: Batch query multiple property keys for efficiency.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieve current telemetry metrics if supported.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Register a listener for telemetry updates.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activate or deactivate the port for video presentation.
